errors.text: The numerical APBE values (~112 and ~100 mJ/m²), long-range-order threshold S > 0.8, and critical temperature near 650°C are asserted without support from the cited evidence and conflict with the target's experimentally identified ductility minimum near 600°C.

The proposed TEM comparison does not adequately distinguish ordering-driven embrittlement from phase decomposition because it lacks quantitative phase-fraction/composition measurements and a phase-fraction-matched control.
